_about: Artifact templates for 1950 (data only). An artifact is a collectible with a TRUE STORY: the object is invented, the story it carries is sourced wherever story.kind is "sourced". Tiers: common, uncommon, rare. NO UNIQUES: those are only ever placed by Felix, from docs/UNIQUE-ARTIFACT-CANDIDATES.md; six lore artifacts are deliberately held back (see heldBack).
_spec: games/windward/docs/ALIVE-SEA.md: "Grill: generated mini quests" (rounds 1 to 3), "the thing model" (rumours, regulars, warmth), "anchoring", "day and night". Ids link to data/things-1950.json (things), artifacts-1950.json, quests-1950.json, rumours-1950.json and data/island-lore.json.
_invented: Everything here is INVENTED unless a record says otherwise: each carries invented:true and a source {kind, refs}. Spoken lines are INVENTED-DIALOGUE, short, for Felix to rewrite by eye. No real private person is named.

_fields.name: the object
_fields.madeEra: when it was made (text, as the lore gives it)
_fields.foundEra: eras it can be found in; ["1950"] here
_fields.story: { kind: sourced | invented, text, refs[], confidence: high | medium | low | none }: the true story it carries; sourced stories contain only claims in the refs
_fields.foundVia: thing ids (secrets, drift finds) that yield it
_fields.foundAt: anchor ids where a close look from an anchored boat finds it
_fields.givenBy: regulars who give it once they like you or after a quest
_fields.teller: the regular who tells the story ("lore is told by a regular who knows", ALIVE-SEA 13)
_fields.leadsTo: { quest: id | null, hook: text | null }: rare artifacts lead to small quests or story hooks (ALIVE-SEA 14)
_fields.sellable: { later, note }: common ones can be sold once there is an economy
_fields.drawing: silhouette slug for the logbook collection page
_fields.lore: { place, hook: artifacts, index } into island-lore.json
